match_evaluation.description: A short explanation of how well the CV matches what is asked in the JD.

items.description: List of requirements for the job position described in the JD.
Mandatory requirements listed in the JD, if any; otherwise null. Account for semantic meaning rather than relying only on explicit words such as `mandatory`.
Optional requirements listed in the JD, if any; otherwise null. Account for semantic meaning rather than relying only on explicit words such as `optional`.
Requirements for the job position that are supported by the CV, if any; otherwise null.
Requirements for the job position that are not supported by the CV, if any; otherwise null.
